solve_lqr_optimal_policy: solve the LQR problem for a dm_control environment and return the optimal value function Hessian, linear policy, and convergence rate
solve_dare_iteratively: solve the discrete-time algebraic Riccati equation by iteration given transition matrix A, control matrix B, and cost matrices Q and R
compute_lqr_gain_matrix: compute the optimal linear feedback gain matrix K for a dm_control LQR environment using the algebraic Riccati equation
check_lqr_stability: check if a controlled LQR system is stable by computing the maximum eigenvalue of the closed-loop state transition matrix
review_lqr_solver: review the LQR solver module that computes optimal policies for dm_control MuJoCo environments using discrete algebraic Riccati equation methods
